base.description: The manager as Panduit ships PR2VD10, both doors fitted.

datasheet.title: PatchRunner 2 Vertical Cable Managers Spec Sheet RKSP172

description: 45RU dual-sided vertical cable manager, 10 in wide, Panduit PatchRunner 2 PR2VD10: a steel backbone with a column of 45 inset ABS fingers down each side of its front channel and of its rear channel, one finger to each rack unit, four 3.0 in round pass-through holes through the backbone, and a full-length dual-hinging push-to-close steel door on the front and another on the rear that ship fitted. It stands on a free-standing base beside a rack and takes no rack unit.

gaps.note: the doors are "dual-hinging" and open to the left or the right on hinge pins; no view draws a hinge, and each door is drawn as one fitted plate that is either on or off.
gaps.wanted: a drawing or a close render of a door's hinge and latch

gaps.note: the front view draws each finger as a loop; it is built as a solid block 30 across and 33 high, and its length (260 front, 175 rear) is estimated from the calculator's channel areas.
gaps.wanted: a section through a finger and the backbone

gaps.note: the drawing's "free standing base", the integrated door brackets and the stand-off from a rack are not drawn or dimensioned.
gaps.wanted: a drawing of the base and its fixing to a rack

gaps.note: the maker's PR2VD DXF (68 MB) and DWG were not read: the figures here come from the PDF drawing's table and views.
gaps.wanted: the DXF read for the finger, hole and door measurements

body.description: the steel backbone, front channel first

doors.description: the full-length doors, front first, shipped fitted

fingers.description: the sections of 15 fingers, left then right, top to bottom; the front channel first

name: pr2vd10

attrs.note: datasheet - the material, colour, standards and what is in the box are the PR2VD10 product page and the specification sheet (RKSP172); the materials are the drawing's.

bottom.note: estimated - the top view again: the two ends of the manager are alike.

capacity.note: datasheet - the Cable Capacity Charts of the Space-Saving bulletin (RKCB46) give the PR2VD10 per cable at the 30 per cent recommended fill and the 50 per cent maximum, the front and the rear separately; the figures stated are the Cat 6 24 AWG 0.235 in (5.97 mm) column at 30 per cent: 569 front (948 at 50 per cent) and 361 rear (601). The Cable Capacity Calculator gives the usable areas, 82.31 and 52.21 sq in. The bulletin notes that slack spools reduce the capacity.

chassis.note: drawing - 254.0 x 2130.4 x 526.4, covers fitted: the PR2VD table's A 10.00 in [254.0], B 83.88 in [2130.4] and C 20.7 in [526.4] for the PR2VD10; the product page gives the same. The Space-Saving bulletin states 10.0 x 84.0 x 20.6 in (254 x 2130 x 523 mm).

color.note: estimated - "The manager is black" on the product page. Every image Panduit publishes of the part is a render; the doors are drawn a shade lighter than the backbone.

depth.note: estimated - the 526.4 is overall. It is drawn as a 303 front channel, a 20.4 backbone and a 203 rear channel (see pr2vd08): the plan view puts the backbone about 41 per cent of the way from the back, and the calculator's areas for the PR2VD10 (82.31 and 52.21 sq in) are in the ratio 1.6:1.

front.note: drawing - the front with the door fitted: the door, and under it the backbone with 45 fingers a side in three sections of 15 and the four holes. The `duct` guide is the channel between the finger columns, run down the height: 224.8 across, the 10 in less the 29.2 the calculator's front area per inch of width (9.3 sq in) leaves, ESTIMATED.

guides.note: estimated - each duct is the channel between the two finger columns of its face, run down the height (`run: y`), with the rack unit's 44.45 pitch and the 11.45 left between 33 mm fingers.

left.note: estimated - no side view of the manager without its doors is dimensioned: the backbone, and the two finger zones along it, built from the plan view and the finger columns' extent.

method.note: FIGURES FROM THE MAKER'S OWN DOCUMENTS, read as the PR2VD08's are (see pr2vd08): the PR2VD** customer drawing (PDF 14V455LV-DC, with a 68 MB DXF and a DWG that were not read), the PatchRunner 2 Vertical Cable Managers specification sheet RKSP172, the product page, the Space-Saving bulletin RKCB46 and the Cable Capacity Calculator. THE FIGURES THE TABLE GIVES ARE `drawing`; EVERYTHING READ OFF THE PICTURES (the split of the depth between the channels, the finger's size, the holes' places) IS ESTIMATED and said so in the part that carries it.

mount.note: drawing - `rack-side`, as the FS vertical ducts and the PR2VD08: the PR2VD drawing (Panduit 14V455LV-DC) draws a "free standing base" and "integrated door brackets". It occupies no rack unit; `ru: 45` is the height it runs beside (the 83.88 in of the table is a 7 ft, 45 RU manager). Which side of the rack is a lab placement to say (docs/vertical-cable-managers-design.md).

rear.note: drawing - the rear with the door fitted, as the front: the PR2VD drawing is titled "front and rear fingers and doors". The `duct` is 212.8 across, the 10 in less the 41.2 that the calculator's rear area per inch of width (6.23 sq in) leaves, ESTIMATED.

right.note: estimated - the left view turned round.

shell.note: drawing - TWO HOLLOW CHANNELS BACK TO BACK, NOT A BOX (see pr2vd08): the backbone as a well 303 deep on the front view and 203 deep on the rear view, each with its fingers and door; both floors open at the four 3.0 in holes.

thickness.note: estimated - no Panduit document states the steel's gauge. 1.5 is a sheet of this kind; the parts carry their own thicknesses.

top.note: estimated - the plan, rear at y=0: the rear fingers, the backbone and the front fingers, built from the plan view of the drawing and the finger lengths above.

weight.note: drawing - 27.7 kg [61.15 lb], the manager and doors unpacked, the weight column of the PR2VD table; 28.6 kg [63.15 lb] shipped.
